lines.zh: 我没有脚，飘着也算走路。
lines.en: I have no feet; drifting counts as walking.
Half a foot up, grass brushes past me.

lines.zh: 我向前滑，空气让开一条路。
lines.en: I slide forward and the air parts for me.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的雾跟着我移动。
lines.en: The Greckon mist moves along with me.

lines.zh: 我飘过石缝，没发出声音。
lines.en: I drift over the crevice without a sound.

lines.zh: 身子往前倾，我就过去了。
lines.en: I lean forward and I am there.

lines.zh: 地面在我下面慢慢倒退。
lines.en: The ground slides backward beneath me.
I hug the cliff and hunt for living things.
No footsteps, only the wind.
I float lower to catch your scent.
Purple haze trails behind me.
I do not go straight; I like to circle.

lines.zh: 我悬在原处，脸的位置空空。
lines.en: I hover in place, empty where a face should be.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，我也能感觉到你。
lines.en: With no eyes, I still sense you.
Mist curls around me.

lines.zh: 我听着这片废墟的动静。
lines.en: I listen to the ruins around me.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，我什么都不缺。
lines.en: Wind passes through me; I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转着，像在找什么。
lines.en: I turn slowly, as if searching.

lines.zh: 紫色的光在我体内亮着。
lines.en: Purple light glows inside me.

lines.zh: 我数着从头顶飘过的云。
lines.en: I count the clouds drifting overhead.
If no one comes, I cling to the wall.
This sky is too bright for me.
I look at you without needing eyes.
You carry warmth; it is very obvious.
My face is empty; do not be afraid.
I am tracing your outline.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，我就知道你怕了。
lines.en: You look up, and I know you are afraid.
Your breathing carries a long way.

lines.zh: 我凑近些，想闻你的心跳。
lines.en: I lean closer to smell your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 面具下面什么都没有，真的。
lines.en: There is nothing under the mask, truly.

lines.zh: 你盯着我找脸，找不到的。
lines.en: You search my face; you will not find it.

lines.zh: 我偏了偏头，算是回应你。
lines.en: I tilt my head as an answer.
You struck where there is no face.
The mist scatters and regathers; I live.
I had almost forgotten what pain is.

lines.zh: 你砍开我，我只是一团雾。
lines.en: You cut me open: I am only mist.
The purple mist pulls inward.
A seam splits across my body.
You hear my low, hollow cry.
My hover wavers for a moment.

lines.zh: 别以为砍开我就结束了。
lines.en: Do not think cutting me open ends it.

lines.zh: 你越打我，我越想贴着你。
lines.en: Pain only makes me want you more.
What is that little light in your hand?
I smell the void on you.

lines.zh: 给我一片虚空鳞，我就满意。
lines.en: Give me one void scale and I am content.

lines.zh: 紫色染料，你身上的颜色。
lines.en: Purple dye, the color you wear.
That fear ingot is going cold.
I come close, but not to eat you.

lines.zh: 举那么高，我的雾够不到。
lines.en: Lift it that high and my mist falls short.
That scent has stopped me.
Hand over a little and I will step aside.
I am not greedy; just a small piece.

lines.zh: 你一头栽进我这团紫雾。
lines.en: You walked into my mist.
I drift aside so we do not touch.

lines.zh: 撞上我的时候，你打了个寒战。
lines.en: You shivered when you bumped me.

lines.zh: 我没什么重量，你却退了。
lines.en: I weigh little, yet you recoil.
Do not shove; I wobble as it is.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀穿过我的雾气。
lines.en: Your shoulder passes through my haze.

lines.zh: 一撞，紫色的雾散了一圈。
lines.en: One bump scatters a ring of purple fog.
I turn against you and cannot be shaken.

lines.zh: 撞得我晃了两下才稳住。
lines.en: The bump rocks me twice before I steady.
We brush past and neither is hurt.

lines.zh: 我们没有脸，照样认得出彼此。
lines.en: Faceless as we are, we still know each other.

lines.zh: 两团雾靠在一起，就是家。
lines.en: Two clouds of mist together make a home.

lines.zh: 它会替我闻风里的活物。
lines.en: It scents living things in the wind for me.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子生来就会飘。
lines.en: Our young float from the moment they exist.

lines.zh: 我不用看它，也知道它在。
lines.en: I need not see it to know it is there.

lines.zh: 雾里多一团影子，不孤单。
lines.en: One more shadow in the mist, no longer alone.
It drifts slower than I do, so I wait.

lines.zh: 两个空脸贴在一起，很安静。
lines.en: Two blank faces meet, and all is quiet.
We share the same purple mist.

lines.zh: 它会记得我的气味，很多年。
lines.en: It will remember my scent for many years.
I take the scale lying on the ground.

lines.zh: 紫色的东西，我都感兴趣。
lines.en: Anything purple interests me.
Who dropped this fear ingot?

lines.zh: 我飘低一点，把东西捞起来。
lines.en: I float lower and scoop the thing up.
If no one wants it, I keep it.
This scale is still a little cold.
I hide it inside my mist.
Picking things up without hands is easy.
This color suits me well.
What did you drop? I will pick it up.
You are still moving, so you are chosen.

lines.zh: 活物的热气把我引过来。
lines.en: The heat of a living thing draws me.
I smell the blood inside you.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我的影子比你先到。
lines.en: Do not run; I drift faster than you.

lines.zh: 我看不见，可我知道你在哪。
lines.en: I cannot see, yet I know where you are.
This mist is mine, and so are you.

lines.zh: 你踏进格瑞克，就算猎物。
lines.en: Step into Greckon and you are prey.
I turn my blank face toward you.
You stomp like a drum.
I have marked you; do not look back.
The purple mist begins to close in.

lines.zh: 你呼出的气，我全收到了。
lines.en: I catch every breath you let out.
Right now, I think only of you.
Your warmth cannot escape me.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾里多了一口热气。
lines.en: One more warm breath inside the purple mist.

lines.zh: 有人踩断了格瑞克的枯枝。
lines.en: Someone snapped a dry branch in Greck.
I float around you, hunting a gap.

lines.zh: 盾牌挡不住没有脸的东西。
lines.en: A shield cannot block a faceless thing.

lines.zh: 我贴近一点，再贴近一点。
lines.en: A little closer, then a little closer.

lines.zh: 你转头找我，我就在你背后。
lines.en: You turn to find me; I am behind you.
The mist blocks your sight.

lines.zh: 你总会露出空门，我不急。
lines.en: You will show a gap; I can wait.
Your sword cannot cut mist.
I hold still, quieter than wind.
You step back; I advance one step.
My mist winds around your ankle.

lines.zh: 你听见低沉的嗡声了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear that low humming?
This close, I smell your fear.

lines.zh: 我的影子叠在你的影子上。
lines.en: My shadow overlaps yours.
Wherever you flee, I arrive first.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊得比雾还薄。
lines.en: I spread myself thinner than the mist.
I have no face, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 我贴着树影，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I hug the tree shadows and drift closer.
You back to the water; the water will not help.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就在你肩上方。
lines.en: Look back: I am just above your shoulder.

lines.zh: 雾在收，你的路只剩一条。
lines.en: The mist closes; you have one road left.

lines.zh: 这一下从你背后穿进去。
lines.en: This strike enters through your back.
This hit arrives in silence.
The cold you feel is me.

lines.zh: 我没有拳头，也能打疼你。
lines.en: No fists, yet I can still hurt you.

lines.zh: 紫色的霜爬上你的皮肤。
lines.en: Purple frost climbs across your skin.
You pull away; I press close again.

lines.zh: 这一抓，抓的是你的气息。
lines.en: This grab takes hold of your breath.
Does it hurt? I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我的空脸贴到了你脸上。
lines.en: My blank face presses against yours.
You swing at air; the mist closes again.
I sweep across your throat.
A purple streak appears on your body.
I put all my strength in that strike.
Your blood thickens the mist.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过你的甲，没有声。
lines.en: My hand passes your armor without a sound.

lines.zh: 你听见风声，那是我抬手。
lines.en: That gust you hear is my arm rising.

lines.zh: 紫色从我指尖钻进你皮肤。
lines.en: Purple seeps from my fingers into your skin.
I graze your ear; it is very cold.
What you cut is only mist and me.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，却让你记很久。
lines.en: This blow is light, but you will remember it.
I rise out of the purple fog.

lines.zh: 格瑞克又多了一个影子。
lines.en: Greckon has gained another shadow.
The air here suits my drifting.
I open eyes that do not exist.
Over the ruins, I circle once.
Another living thing enters this fog.
I was born hanging in midair.

lines.zh: 上方漏下来的光太刺眼。
lines.en: The light leaking down is too harsh.
The mist has not cleared; I wait.
I squeeze out of the crack.
This place will soon go quiet.
I arrive wearing purple all over.
Fire burned away a layer of me.
Wingless, I drop fast.
Water fills my mist and I grow heavy.
The explosion tears me into two mists.
The arrow leaves a hole in my fog.
Magic sears the mist; that truly hurts.
I find no warmth to feed on and fade.
Lightning through me lights me whole.
The void opens its mouth and swallows me.
